notes.title: June progress update
notes.notes:
Sorry for the delay in this month's update! I was sick for two weeks in June, so development was a bit slow. I'm feeling much better now, so here's the June update!

Spent 22 hours discussing the game plot with friends, overhauled it twice, and finally locked down the outlines for all 7 routes.

Designed trigger criteria for Moments and Endings in 5 out of 7 routes.

Drew and implemented chibi animations for daily activities such as studying and working.



In all love triangle routes, a scale UI will appear at the top of the screen. When you interact with one LI, the heart marker will move toward him a little bit. If you get too close, you might exit the triangle and enter his solo route. To complete the full love triangle route, play strategically and try to stay in the middle.

notes.title: May progress update
notes.notes:
Hello! It's time for my monthly update!
Over the course of April, I've finished the story outlines for:
- Yonhi solo route
- Masaki solo route
- Tetsu solo route 
- Masaki vs Tetsu route 
- Tetsu vs Masaki route 

Here wraps all routes’ outlines except for the MC solo route. 
And yes, "Masaki vs Tetsu" and "Tetsu vs Masaki" are two completely different love triangle routes. 

In the 2nd semester, you can buy and change clothes when dating. LIs have different preferences on your look, but they wouldn’t be impressed if you wear the same clothes two dates on a row (even if it’s their favourite style) so choose wisely <3

notes.title: April progress update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Just in case you've forgotten about me, I’ll be posting monthly dev updates from now on. Here’s what I’ve done over the past two months:


 Finished the script of Yonhi vs. Masaki love triangle route
 Finished the outline of the the main story, and implemented the stats raising system for Graduation Project Thesis
 Finished the outline of Yonhi vs. Tetsu love triangle route
 Completed about 80% outline of all LIs' solo routes



Also, here’s a little sneak peek at the intimacy mode in the 2nd semester: 

You can go on Sunday dates with LIs who have 200+ affection. If it goes well, they’ll ask for an extra walk, which unlocks some intimate interactions. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45461734/8ce0d37c29f019eed26bb7ec4bd28637af4b93ea.png

And if you turn them on but leave them dry, they’ll need a bit *self-care* later at home.
